Profile.Headline: Senior Software Engineer | FinTech | Python | React | AWS
Profile.Summary: Senior Software Engineer with 6 years of experience building scalable financial technology solutions. Expert in Python/Django, React.js, and cloud infrastructure on AWS. Led development of payment processing systems at two FinTech startups. Passionate about clean code, system design, and mentoring junior engineers. Strong track record of delivering high-impact projects in agile environments.

Positions.Title: Senior Software Engineer
Positions.Description: Lead engineer for real-time payment settlement platform. Architected microservices handling £150M+ in annual transactions. Built with Python/Django, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka. Managed team of 3 engineers. Implemented PCI DSS compliant payment flows. Reduced system latency by 45% through caching and query optimization.

Positions.Title: Software Engineer
Positions.Description: Full-stack developer for mobile banking application. Built REST APIs with Django REST Framework. Developed React Native mobile app features. Integrated with banking core systems via SOAP APIs. Implemented SEPA and Faster Payments support.

Positions.Title: Junior Developer
Positions.Description: Built web applications with Python/Flask and JavaScript. Implemented user authentication, database models, and REST endpoints. Participated in code reviews and agile ceremonies.

Projects.Title: Open Source Payment Gateway SDK
Projects.Description: Python SDK for integrating with multiple payment providers. Supports Stripe, PayPal, and Adyen. 2,800 GitHub stars.

Projects.Description: Dashboard for monitoring payment transactions in real-time using React, WebSockets, and D3.js.
